evaluation_design.detail: Design uses T0016 pilot only after exact local identity verification, whole-family train/validation/test separation and no test access before freeze. Metrics are token-weighted NTP NLL per valid label, per language and aggregate; bits/byte with explicit UTF-8 coverage and BOS/EOS/pad reconciliation; PPL only with identical tokenizer. Two guardrails are key-value retrieval with distractors and compositional pattern/arithmetic completion, with unseen generators and chance baselines. Planning design is 3 arms x 3 seeds x 128 updates B1/T512, 46,076 training NTP labels per pass, 1,152 updates and 589,824 valid-token presentations. Proposed margins: NTP NLL +0.05 noninferiority / -0.03 meaningful advantage, bits/byte +0.01, guardrail -2 pp, cost +10% descriptive; paired bootstrap over held-out blocks/families. Estimated 45-75 minutes, up to about 2 hours with tuning, from accepted T0012/T0011 anchors; rough planning only. Margins and budget are not preregistered until review.

limitations: Analysis/design only: no model training, architecture implementation, data acquisition, package install, GPU/MPS use, test access or private checkpoint access.
Local Mac has no torch; parameter and MAC formulas were not instantiated as modules locally.
Candidate counts are ideal contraction arithmetic and exclude backward, optimizer, padding, memory traffic and kernel efficiency.
The T0016 pilot is small and not representative; no quality or scaling claim is possible from this design.
The 3-seed budget and proposed margins are planning proposals, not a powered confirmatory protocol or preregistered gates.
The 45-75 minute budget is extrapolated from different accepted synthetic measurements and may not transfer to the matched study.
T0017 real-pilot results are not accepted and were not used; no T0017 checkpoint or test data was accessed.
